description:
LANDED d1ccfdea2 (merged to wt/kdt13-boundaries 2026-08-31; adversarial
review MERGE, two LOW prose findings folded before landing).

THE DEFECT, wider than first framed: not return-vs-payload but
return-vs-RETURN across mutual recursion (reduce_while_cont <->
reduce_while_step, plus the Range twins). The structural cut falls on one
side of a cycle; the cut member settles on the evidence beside its cut
arm while the member whose edge survived joins that form with its own
arms, finds no agreement, and invents a whole-value lane. CallReturnFlow
demands source == caller_return == payload for Tail, so BOTH directions
demoted -- 13-14 tail->continue edges, measured +20-26% on a 30k-element
split_while/split_with (two machines). Base "agreed" only because the
deleted lottery stamped one layout group-wide (below the analyzed ty --
one of the 26 defects fz-kdt.93 corrected).

THE FIX (the fold-concordant third shape, after measuring both ticket
candidates): an ExecutableReturn whose recipe names an in-component
DIRECT return publishes THE CONTRACT -- the form its own type and demand
describe -- via one named function contract_transport_layout that both
sides of the convention reach by construction. Trigger reuses
settled_component (no new fact, no scheduler state; kdt.93 constraints
intact). Candidate (a) (payload prefers callee's return) REJECTED on
evidence: it settles the payload against the very return that invents
alone -- repaired only the cut-side payloads, runtime moved ~2%.
Carve-outs recorded in fz-kdt.100 (widened per review): callable-demand
returns (fz-9i4.4.5 one-authority; carve-out proven canon-neutral) and
closure-carried data cycles (grounded arm reports no in-component answer;
commented at the arm).

RED-FIRST: compiler2_one_recursion_component_publishes_one_return_contract
-- drives the real backend product on take_drop, reads the artifact's own
call graph back, binds on mutual reachability + equal return type (demand-
equality assumption documented in the test after review F2). RED at base
with exactly the 14 demoted edges; GREEN after.

RESULTS (builder + refuter independent reproduction): deep_split 30k AOT
57.5s -> 44.7-45.1s (base band 45.5; refuter's own builds 56.7 -> 45.1);
tail/continue take_drop 136/16 -> 152/0 (better than pre-kdt.93's 149/3
-- base's own 3 residual demotions repaired), predicate 163/2 -> 165/0;
decomposed return layouts KEPT AND EXTENDED (141 -> 167 across the three
lenses; predicate's kdt.93 loss recovered). Canon-gate vs base 206/8/0
lines, all in the reduce_while family; zero carrier/clause_ids/inventory
movement; lane-above-ty gate green; contract provably never wider than
evidence (contract = analyzed-ty-shaped; evidence >= ty by the kdt.93
gate). Order-invariance: byte-identical under pending.reverse(); refuter
went further (full LIFO agenda) -- kdt.97 adds ZERO schedule-dependence
(residual LIFO movement is pre-existing renumbering + the fz-kdt.96
lottery). Trigger proven monotone under origin resolution (one-way
evidence->contract). Behavior byte-identical 6 fixtures both lanes.
Fresh gate on merged HEAD: lib 1517/0, cli 23/0, matrix 425/0, clippy -D
warnings, fmt clean. No ratchet re-pins needed.
title: DONE: one recursion component publishes one return contract (d1ccfdea2; deep_split 57.5s -> 44.9s, tail/continue 152/0)
